prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore with workspace-only 404 isolation and positional restoration of deleted episodes and their cuts, an Undo action in the delete toast on the Episodes page in English and Korean, changelog entry, and backend tests.

+@router.post("/{episode_id}/duplicate", response_model=EpisodeOut)
+def duplicate_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),

+    """
+    Duplicate an episode and all of its cuts within the same project.
+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)
+    if not episode or episode.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    ws_member = session.exec(
+        select(WorkspaceMember).where(
+            WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == project.workspace_id,
+            WorkspaceMember.user_id == UUID(current_user_id),
+        )
+    ).first()
+    if not ws_member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    active_episodes = _active_episodes_ordered(session, episode.project_id)
+    orig_index = next(
+        (idx for idx, ep in enumerate(active_episodes) if ep.id == episode.id),
+        len(active_episodes) - 1,
+    )
+
+    new_episode = Episode(
+        project_id=episode.project_id,
+        title=f"{episode.title} (Copy)",
+        story_summary=episode.story_summary,
+        episode_order=orig_index + 2,
+        status="ready",
+        background_info=episode.background_info,
+        character_outfits=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_outfits) if episode.character_outfits is not None else {},
+    )
+    session.add(new_episode)
+
+    updated_order = (
+        active_episodes[: orig_index + 1]
+        + [new_episode]
+        + active_episodes[orig_index + 1 :]
+    )
+    _renumber_episodes(session, updated_order)
+    session.flush()
+
+    orig_cuts = session.exec(

+    for cut in orig_cuts:

+            script=cut.script,
+            location=cut.location,
+            time_of_day=cut.time_of_day,
+            transition_ref=cut.transition_ref,
+            selected_layout=cut.selected_layout,
+            aspect_ratio=cut.aspect_ratio,
+            image_path=cut.image_path,
+            image_asset_id=cut.image_asset_id,
+            status=cut.status if cut.status != "generating" else "idle",
+            dialogues=copy.deepcopy(cut.dialogues) if cut.dialogues is not None else [],
+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(cut.appearing_characters) if cut.appearing_characters is not None else [],
+            embedding=list(cut.embedding) if cut.embedding is not None else None,
+            refer_prev_cut=cut.refer_prev_cut,
+        )
+        session.add(new_cut)

+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)

+    return _serialize_episode(session, new_episode)

+@router.post("/{episode_id}/restore", response_model=EpisodeOut)
+def restore_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Restore a soft-deleted episode and its cuts at its previous position,
+    shifting subsequent episodes down by one place.
+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)
+    if not episode:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    ws_member = session.exec(
+        select(WorkspaceMember).where(
+            WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == project.workspace_id,
+            WorkspaceMember.user_id == UUID(current_user_id),
+        )
+    ).first()
+    if not ws_member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    if episode.deleted_at is None:
+        return _serialize_episode(session, episode)
+
+    active_episodes = _active_episodes_ordered(session, episode.project_id)
+    target_pos = max(1, min(episode.episode_order, len(active_episodes) + 1))
+    insert_idx = target_pos - 1
+
+    episode.deleted_at = None
+    session.add(episode)
+
+    updated_order = (
+        active_episodes[:insert_idx]
+        + [episode]
+        + active_episodes[insert_idx:]
+    )
+    _renumber_episodes(session, updated_order)
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(episode)
+
+    return _serialize_episode(session, episode)
+

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="The journey begins."):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(
+    client,
+    headers,
+    episode_id,
+    *,
+    cut_order,
+    script,
+    selected_layout="single",
+    aspect_ratio="9:16",
+    dialogues=None,
+    appearing_characters=None,
+    image_path=None,
+):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": selected_layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    if appearing_characters is not None:
+        r = client.put(
+            f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}",
+            headers=headers,
+            json={"appearing_characters": appearing_characters},
+        )
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+        cut = r.json()
+    return cut
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_copies_metadata_cuts_and_places_right_after_original(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Rainy Stop", order=1, summary="A strange bus arrives.")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Midnight Tunnel", order=2, summary="The lights flicker.")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Dawn Terminal", order=3, summary="The doors open.")
+
+    # Add context fields to ep1
+    r = client.put(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "background_info": "Wet neon bus stop at midnight",
+            "character_outfits": {"Mina": "Yellow raincoat"},
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    cut1 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Mina waits under the awning.",
+        selected_layout="wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Last bus already?"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": str(uuid4()), "name": "Mina"}],
+        image_path="cuts/ep1/panel1.png",

+    cut2 = _create_cut(

+def test_restore_deleted_episode_returns_at_original_place_with_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1, summary="First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2, summary="Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3, summary="Third")
+
+    cut1 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Mina steps onto the bus.",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Wait!"}],
+        image_path="cuts/ep2/1.png",
+    )
+    cut2 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="The doors hiss shut.",
+        dialogues=[],
+        image_path="cuts/ep2/2.png",
+    )
+
+    # Delete ep2 (order 2) -> ep3 closes gap to order 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    eps = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in eps] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in eps] == [1, 2]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json() == []
+
+    # Restore ep2 -> returns at order 2, ep3 shifts back down to order 3
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)

+def test_restore_edge_positions_and_idempotency(client):

+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)

+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    # Delete first episode (ep1 at 1) and restore it -> shifts ep2, ep3 down
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=h)

+    assert res.json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    eps = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in eps] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in eps] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Calling restore again on an already active episode is a no-op and preserves numbering
+    res_again = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res_again.status_code == 200, res_again.text
+    eps = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in eps] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in eps] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Delete ep3 (order 3) and ep2 (order 2), then restore ep3 -> clamped to 2 (no gap!)
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    res3 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res3.status_code == 200, res3.text
+    assert res3.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    eps = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in eps] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in eps] == [1, 2]
